(() => { const pw = window.pokewatch, E = pw.ctx.enemies; const n = 4, gap = 5.5;
  return ["snorlax","onix","wailord","eternatus"].map((id, k) => { const i = pw.spawn(id, (k - (n - 1) / 2) * gap, -2); E.speed[i] = 0; E.hp[i] = E.maxHp[i] = 1e6; return { id, i, x: E.x[i], z: E.z[i] }; }); })()
